_notes.intent: Strongest faithful ML2DAC: full application phase with meta-learning CVI selection (cvi='predict'), warmstart configurations, and algorithm/search-space reduction (limit_cs). Optimizer = SMAC Bayesian optimization. This is the paper-level setup, NOT an ablation.
_notes.budget: SMAC enforces BOTH runcount-limit=n_optimizer_loops (100, includes the n_warmstarts=25) AND wallclock-limit=time_budget_sec (120s). Whichever is hit first stops optimization. time_budget_sec maps directly to a real wall-clock limit.
_notes.mf_set_index: 4 = ['statistical','info-theory','general'] -> the paper-strongest meta-feature set; trained CVI classifier present at models/RandomForestClassifier/statistical+info-theory+general/None.
_notes.random_state: ML2DAC fixes random_state=1234 internally (SMAC rng + clustering algos); the config value is recorded for provenance but ML2DAC's internal seed governs determinism.
_notes.normalize_input: ML2DAC StandardScales the input internally; the adapter passes the raw partition space (no double scaling).
_notes.mkr_path: null = use the shipped MetaKnowledgeRepository at external/ml2dac/src/MetaKnowledgeRepository. Set to a path to use a user-provided MKR.
_notes.fairness: ML2DAC receives only the partition space. No true labels, no true K, no metric utilities, no family metadata (true_labels=None passed internally).
